authorization: User explicitly allowed frozen development observable transactions and diagnostic metadata on this turn. Train/Validation only; no holdouts.

candidate_features.current: type and endpoints only; no current amount
candidate_features.formula: Number of prior W2W edges receiver(T)->sender(T) in (t-7d,t], with key < key(T). Zero for non-W2W or self-loop.
candidate_features.meaning: Repeated reverse-direction relationships beyond the selected shortest path
candidate_features.name: candidate_prior_reciprocal_count_7d
candidate_features.non_oracle: No current/edge amount gates, no multi-edge qualifying-path conjunction or target.
candidate_features.prior: observable directed edges, strictly smaller timestamp/integer-ID keys
candidate_features.zero_missing: zero means no reciprocal edge or non-applicable role; no missing marker

candidate_features.formula: Count edge-pairs r->m and m->s with three distinct nodes, both in (t-7d,t], key(edge1)<key(edge2)<key(T). Each edge-pair counts once. Zero for non-W2W/self-loop.
candidate_features.meaning: Multiplicity of short return routes, not restricted to the selected path
candidate_features.name: candidate_prior_two_hop_return_count_7d
candidate_features.non_oracle: No monetary filtering, current return ratio, lengths 3..5 or complete cycle predicate.
candidate_features.prior: observable edges with increasing full keys
candidate_features.zero_missing: zero when no chronological two-edge route; no missing marker

candidate_features.current: type/endpoints select the prior path; current amount excluded
candidate_features.formula: max_j abs(log(amount(edge[j+1])/amount(edge[j]))) over adjacent edges in the Stage 10A selected chronological simple path of 1..5 prior edges. One-edge path=0; absent/non-W2W=-1.
candidate_features.meaning: Continuous value variation along a selected prior path
candidate_features.name: candidate_selected_path_max_log_value_change
candidate_features.non_oracle: No amount-gated path search, predicate cutoffs, current ratio gate or any-qualifying-path output.
candidate_features.prior: Stage 10A topology selection: shortest path, latest first edge, then lexicographic edge-key sequence
candidate_features.zero_missing: one-edge path has no adjacent discrepancy (0); absent path uses -1

candidate_features.current: current agent service/type; no cash principal assigned to W2W
candidate_features.formula: Cash-In plus Cash-Out service count / all service-event count in (t-24h,t], including permitted current service. Assisted W2W only enters denominator.
candidate_features.meaning: Cash activity relative to all agent service activity
candidate_features.name: candidate_agent_cash_service_share_24h
candidate_features.non_oracle: No cash-count minimum, unique-wallet count, direction thresholds or complete imbalance conjunction.
candidate_features.zero_missing: zero without agent/services; no missing marker

candidate_features.formula: abs(sum(skew_j)/4), where skew_j=(cashout_value-cashin_value)/(cashout_value+cashin_value) in each of four disjoint 6h buckets (t-(j+1)*6h,t-j*6h], j=0..3; empty-cash bucket skew=0. Current service enters j=0.
candidate_features.meaning: Persistence of a common cash direction across time, discounted by inactive buckets
candidate_features.name: candidate_agent_cash_direction_persistence_24h
candidate_features.non_oracle: No complete A4 count, wallet breadth, magnitude/change or current-role conjunction.
candidate_features.prior: same-agent history, key < key(T); no future buckets
candidate_features.zero_missing: zero with no cash/agent or balanced opposing bucket directions; no missing marker

candidate_features.baseline: at least 12 baseline services and 8 baseline cash events, full 29d observation; no recent eligibility gate
candidate_features.current: current cash value included; assisted W2W contributes zero cash
candidate_features.formula: Recent 24h Cash-In+Cash-Out minor-unit value / max(1, preceding disjoint 28d cash value / 28). Baseline B=(t-29d,t-1d], recent R=(t-1d,t].
candidate_features.meaning: Unsigned cash magnitude relative to the agent own earlier activity
candidate_features.name: candidate_agent_cash_value_acceleration_24h
candidate_features.non_oracle: No signed imbalance/change gates, recent count/breadth conjunction, private activation or predicate outcome.
candidate_features.prior: same-agent observed services; full baseline coverage from first observed service <=t-29d
candidate_features.zero_missing: -1 without agent or eligible baseline; valid zero if no recent cash; denominator floor one minor unit

decision_order: A if eligible; otherwise B if >=.002 Macro F1 gain and no N3/A4 loss but dependence>=.15 or top share>.5; otherwise C if dependence gate passes but aggregate tradeoffs fail; otherwise D if every candidate fails the joint N3/A4 improvement gates; otherwise E retain reference.
dependence_rule: Stage12 index=max(0, drops in Macro F1, recall, F1, AP, increase in FPR). LOW <.02; MODERATE [.02,.05); HIGH [.05,.15); EXTREME >=.15. Full-versus-matched-retrained removal within each family/representation.
importance: Same permutation-AP method: three repeats, fixed seed20260928, 3000 Validation rows, n_jobs1. Raw values, absolute mass shares. Computed for all eight serious R0-R3 models.
metrics: Accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1, suspicious precision/recall/F1, normal recall, AP, ROC-AUC, FPR, confusion; domains, all12 families, all normal slices, domain-only and unique multidomain union; Train-Val Macro F1 gap.
selection_order: All gates required. Eligible candidates ordered by lower dependence, larger minimum N3/A4 recall, lower H1+H5 FPR, higher Macro F1, name. No hidden weighted score. S2/S4 excluded.
serious_candidates: R0/R1/R2/R3 per family; only R1/R2/R3 eligible for added-feature recommendation. Every serious model has matched retraining without growth.
stop_conditions: Stop after exactly15 new fits; no adaptive additions
Abort on protection mismatch, input/ID/range/causality failure or fit failure
No threshold/calibration search, Train+Val fit, final freeze or application integration
Preserve Stage9/10A/11/12 evidence and all raw inputs
